industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: EDP Renovaveis, S.A.
summary: EDP Renováveis, S.A., a renewable energy company, plans, constructs, operates, and maintains electricity generating power stations. The company operates wind and solar farms. As of December 31, 2020, it had an installed capacity of 4,966 megawatts in Europe; 6,766 megawatts in North America; and 436 megawatts in Brazil. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain. EDP Renováveis, S.A. is a subsidiary of EDP-Energias de Portugal, S.A.
